## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (no test calls a real exchange)

- [ ] Docs updated; `python scripts/generate.py --check` passes
- [ ] Schema compatibility considered (schema version bumped if a field was removed or retyped)
- [ ] Methodology impact considered (version bumped and documented if a formula changed)
- [ ] Exchange docs verified from current official sources (adapter changes)
- [ ] Data rights considered (venue terms, attribution)
- [ ] Fixtures are sanitised and their origin is recorded
- [ ] Changelog entry added
